messages:
Nadia: Quick note  we need a short policy for marketplace onboarding credits before the next vendor wave. Can we triage today?

Victor: I can join for 20m. We need: per-customer vs per-partner, expiry, reporting, and clawback. Also align on tiers.

Lina: From partner ops POV: recommend per-customer credits for listing incentives, per-partner credits for initial SI enablement. Keep expiry at 180 days.

Tom: Engineering ask: credits that convert to compute should have an "integration verification" flag so we can track successful usage (customers who actually run in prod). Otherwise we see fake redemptions.

Maya: Marketing input: co-marketing MDF needs a separate pool. Those credits should require a joint campaign and 4-week lead time. mkt-bot will enforce checklist.

mkt-bot: Reminder: co-marketing checklist template -> https://drive.redwood.ai/co-marketing-checklist (use for approvals).

Nadia: Draft policy suggestion:
- Marketplace listing credit: 5k credits per unique customer (credited when partner initiates offer)
- SI enablement bundle: 50k credits + 6 dev hours (per-partner, one-time)
- Co-marketing MDF: approval + matching requirement, capped by tier
- Expiry: 180 days for credits, 360 for approved co-marketing pools
- Verification: redemption requires either customer activation event or integration validation report

Victor: Numbers look sane. Need caps by tier. Propose: Bronze cap 20k, Silver 75k, Gold 250k. SI bundle counts against the cap.

Lina: Add a hygiene rule: unused credits older than 45 days of inactivity flagged and partners notified, and a reclaim window of 30 days. After that, credits expire.

Tom: For tracking, I'll add a tag field to billing entries: partner_credit_type=[marketplace|si|mkt] and verification_status=[pending|validated|failed]. We can then surface in Console.

Maya: Marketing approves the co-marketing cadence. Also ask that PR approvals require 10 business days lead time, not 2 weeks, for sprint alignment.

Nadia: Two operational Qs: 1) Who signs off on clawbacks? 2) How do we surface redemption reports to partners?

Victor: Ops + Finance co-sign clawbacks. For reports, a monthly partner dashboard export should be available (CSV + Console view).

Lina: I'll prototype a CSV layout this week with columns: partner, tier, credit_type, issued_ts, redeemed_ts, redemption_amount, verification_status, customer_id(optional).

Tom: Note on fraud: tie marketplace per-customer credits to unique customer billing id; if same billing id reappears, flag for review.

mkt-bot: New calendar event created: "Partner credits policy review" 2024-06-12 09:00 PT. Invite sent to: Nadia, Victor, Lina, Tom, Maya.

Nadia: I'll publish a 1-page policy and the CSV sample before the review. Thanks all, this saved time. :tada:
